questions.question: At Jesus' trial before the high priest, what did false witnesses say they heard Jesus claim about the temple?

answers.text: He would destroy it and build another in three days
He would tear it down and never build again
He would rebuild it larger over seven years

questions.question: When the high priest asked Jesus if He was the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One, Jesus said that He was. True or false?
When a servant girl told Peter he had been with Jesus the Nazarene, how did Peter answer her?

answers.text: He said he did not know what she meant
He said yes and asked where Jesus was
He told her to go ask the officers

questions.question: After Peter denied Jesus three times and the rooster crowed, what did Peter do?

answers.text: He went back to the fire
